value.rationale: Canonical Weierstrass weights are natural invariant data. The result provides a complete parameter-dependent classification on two distinguished 16-point branch fibers of a natural genus-17 symmetric Humbert–Edge family, exhibiting symmetry-forced generic weight 23 (above the general-moduli bound 21) and two algebraically distinct jumps to 27. The exact loci and gap mechanisms are informative beyond a routine computation.
